title: Half Day Private Getaway to Ile d'Orléans
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
During your stay in Quebec City, let yourself be charmed by the unmissable Île d’Orléans. This one-day tour invites you to explore its bucolic landscapes and enjoy the delights of the local terroir.

Along the way, you will visit unique establishments where you can taste ciders, wines and other iconic craft products of the region. Enjoy a breathtaking view of Quebec City from the island.

With our VIP service, relax and fully enjoy this experience without having to worry about driving. Immerse yourself in an authentic atmosphere, away from the bustle of Old Quebec, and let yourself be seduced by the heritage charm of Île d’Orléans. 

Bench available: $10 each.
